name: io.github.Prohect/bind-alias-mcp
description: MCP bridge for BindAlias Minecraft mod: game state, screenshots, aliases, and config editing.

tools.name: getState
tools.description: Get Minecraft game state: screen, world, dimension, player pos/rot, health, held item. Returns JSON.

tools.name: getScreenshot
tools.description: Take a Minecraft screenshot and return it as a base64-encoded PNG with path and name.

tools.name: runAlias
tools.description: Execute a registered BindAlias alias. 34+ argless + 18 arg-based aliases. Returns {ok: true}.

tools.name: defineAlias
tools.description: Define a new alias via /alias command. Requires being in a world. Returns {ok: true}.

tools.name: readCFG
tools.description: Read the raw content of bind-alias.cfg. Returns {content: '...'}.

tools.name: writeCFG
tools.description: Overwrite bind-alias.cfg with new content and reload it. Returns {ok: true}.
